Vendored: the core, the Metal renderer backend (macOS in-game menu,
libs/video/ps3_overlay.mm) and -- same tag, from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocornut/imgui/v1.92.9b/backends/ -- the
Vulkan renderer and SDL2 platform backends (imgui_impl_vulkan.*,
imgui_impl_sdl2.*) for the Vulkan overlay (libs/video/vk_overlay.cpp).
imgui.h fetched from that tag is byte-identical to the one here.
The Metal overlay feeds input itself, so imgui_impl_osx is not used.
Upgrade by replacing these files from a newer release.
